paragraphs: Your Genesys Cloud org, as tables you can search, audit and export.
Users with their queues and roles, routing, telephony, Architect, outbound, quality, WFM and more:
53 read-only reports, one click each, as CSV or JSON, on Windows, macOS, Linux and in the browser.
features: Every picture is Pyramid itself against a made-up org (tests/fakegenesys.py), captured by scripts/screenshots.py and scripts/webcheck.py, which also open every report as an end-to-end test.
The Reports tab: 53 reports in 12 sections.

Users, teams and directory; telephony and Architect; routing and queues; security; configuration; integrations; quality; recording; outbound; WFM; stations and presence; analytics and gamification. Hover a button for…
Reports open side by side in tabs, dark theme.
Each report opens in its own tab next to Reports, so you can compare queues with IVRs with trunks. Reopening a report switches to its tab; Ctrl+W closes one, middle-click too. Up to 12 stay open.

whatItDoes.text: Your Genesys Cloud org, as tables you can search, audit and export.

requirements.text: Desktop, browser, terminal A native window for Windows, macOS and Linux, the same reports in the browser with your Genesys login, and a command line for scheduled snapshots.
